label: G.652.D loose-tube 144F
notes: Twelve tubes of 12. Attenuation here is typical installed performance, not a G.652.D limit: 0.35 dB/km at 1310 nm sits under the recommendation's 0.40 dB/km maximum (1310-1625 nm), and 0.21 dB/km at 1550 nm under its 0.30 dB/km maximum (1530-1565 nm). 1490 nm is a typical, interpolated value: no ITU-T recommendation publishes a 1490 nm attenuation figure of its own (G.652.D's 0.40 dB/km maximum spans 1310-1625 nm but is not a 1490 nm specification), so 0.22 dB/km bridges the two published windows and is not a citation. Replace all three with the bought cable's test report for a construction-grade budget.
